THE ESCALATED SIDE OF THE FALSIFIER, run on EALabTpl\Boss_14_GridLog with the SAME effective config as the wrapper baseline. It exists so the probe pair is parent-vs-parent and differs only in LotProg. Compare THIS against the flat-lot arm -- not the wrapper baseline, which differs in the binary too.

PARENT-SIDE BY NECESSITY: LotProg is a LOCKED_SELECTOR, so the wrapper compiles it to a const and cannot express its own falsifier. Run on EALabTpl\Boss_14_GridLog with the wrapper effective config + LotProg=PROG_NONE. Comparable only because parity holds on all seven points of design 5.5 for this configuration.
This is the FALSIFIER ARM of the pre-registration, not a tuning result. It is not a verdict.
probe_why: the escalated arm placed 2 distinct volumes and the trade lists differ, so the progression did something the flat-lot arm did not. The falsifier comparison is meaningful for this cell -- which is a statement about the MEASUREMENT being valid, not about the outcome.
